parsed.notes: Reviewed every group_inventory.jsonl row under lens B using only disclosed local files.

reasons: Dickerson record identifies 530 U.S. 428 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
No disclosed treatment override defeats the § 3501/Miranda constitutional-rule use.
Orozco record identifies 394 U.S. 324 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
No disclosed overruling, abrogation, or limitation affects the custody-in-bedroom use.
Howes record identifies 565 U.S. 499 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
No point override or disclosed progeny defeats the imprisonment-is-not-automatic-custody treatment.
Mathis record is marked caution, but its scope note says the holding stands for unrelated-matter questioning of an already confined person.
The disclosed limitation is only against reading imprisonment itself as always Miranda custody under Howes.
residual_risks: Standalone table should not be read as imprisonment automatically equals custody.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add a short Howes limitation parenthetical in the table if this row will be consumed without the surrounding text.

reasons: Chavez record identifies 538 U.S. 760 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note says the Self-Incrimination holding was reaffirmed and clarified by Vega.
Vega record identifies 597 U.S. 134 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note calls it a recent controlling decision; no disclosed negative treatment defeats the § 1983/remedy assertion.
Florida v. Powell record identifies 559 U.S. 50 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms the reasonably-convey standard for Miranda warnings.
Miranda record identifies 384 U.S. 436 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note says Miranda was reaffirmed as a constitutional rule in Dickerson.
Bruder record identifies 488 U.S. 9 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms Bruder as a per curiam application of Berkemer to roadside DUI questioning before arrest.
Escobedo record is caution, not dead law; the point override says the result stands but the theory was recast and confined.
The page row expressly flags the recast/confined historical-precedent treatment.
Prysock record identifies 453 U.S. 355 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note says Prysock was reaffirmed and applied by Duckworth and Powell.
residual_risks: Lake record status is under_review, but the disclosed treatment judgment is good_law.

reasons: Muniz record identifies 496 U.S. 582 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms the booking-question exception, sixth-birthday suppression, and non-testimonial slurred-speech treatment.
Malloy record identifies 378 U.S. 1 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms Fifth Amendment incorporation against the States and the Miranda predicate.
Beckwith record identifies 425 U.S. 341 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms custody, not investigative focus, triggers Miranda.
Dunaway record identifies 442 U.S. 200 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms station-house detention for interrogation requires probable cause and Miranda warnings alone do not attenuate an illegal arrest.
Brewer record identifies 430 U.S. 387 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms the Sixth Amendment holding remains intact; Nix affected remedy, not Brewer's right-to-counsel holding.
Innis record identifies 446 U.S. 291 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
No disclosed point override or treatment field defeats the functional-equivalent interrogation rule.
Mauro record identifies 481 U.S. 520 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms the recorded spousal visit was not interrogation or its functional equivalent under Innis.
Corley record identifies 556 U.S. 303 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms it is the modern federal McNabb-Mallory prompt-presentment rule, separate from Miranda and not binding on States.
Quarles record identifies 467 U.S. 649 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms Quarles establishes the public-safety exception to Miranda.
Beheler record identifies 463 U.S. 1121 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms the formal-arrest or arrest-equivalent-restraint custody formulation.
Perkins record identifies 496 U.S. 292 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms no Miranda warnings are required when an undercover jailhouse agent draws out statements absent a police-dominated atmosphere known to the suspect.
Duckworth record identifies 492 U.S. 195 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note says the reasonably-conveys standard was applied and reaffirmed in Florida v. Powell.
J.D.B. record identifies 564 U.S. 261 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
No disclosed treatment override defeats the known-or-apparent child-age custody rule.
Berkemer record identifies 468 U.S. 420 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
No disclosed point override defeats the all-offenses/ordinary-traffic-stop use.
residual_risks: Lake record status is under_review, but the disclosed treatment judgment is good_law.

reasons: Stansbury record identifies 511 U.S. 318 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
No disclosed limitation defeats the objective-custody/undisclosed-suspicion proposition.
Alvarado record identifies 541 U.S. 652 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms the AEDPA clearly-established-law framing and states J.D.B. later qualified juveniles while distinguishing Alvarado.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the AEDPA qualifier adjacent to this row whenever excerpted.

reasons: Kaupp record identifies 538 U.S. 626 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms the per curiam Dunaway/Brown application and that the confession is fruit absent attenuation.
Mathiason record identifies 429 U.S. 492 and marks field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
Scope note confirms voluntary station-house interview is not custody.

defect.evidence_quote: The §2254(d) habeas-review framework was later changed by AEDPA (1996); see Yarborough v. Alvarado for custody under AEDPA deference.
defect.problem: The current table states Thompson's independent federal review point without the disclosed AEDPA limitation, making the currency treatment overbroad for habeas review.
defect.proposed_fix: Revise to: custody is a two-part objective inquiry and mixed question; Thompson supplied independent federal review pre-AEDPA, but AEDPA habeas deference is governed by Yarborough/§2254(d).

reasons: Thompson remains field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
The lake scope note expressly limits the independent-federal-review framing after AEDPA.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add an AEDPA caveat anywhere Thompson is used for standard of review.

reasons: Lens B only: Miranda and Quarles records are both field_i_validity=good_law as of 2026-06-30.
No disclosed treatment field or point override defeats the callout's current-law framing of the Miranda gate and public-safety exception.
residual_risks: Support and quote fidelity were not reviewed under lens B.
